context.problem_statement: Apply K-means clustering to segment customers based on their purchase behavior. Features to use: avg_order_value, purchase_frequency, days_since_last_purchase, product_category_diversity. Standardize features before clustering. Find the optimal number of clusters using the elbow method (k=2 to 8, compute inertia). Also compute silhouette scores for each k. Report the optimal k, cluster centers (in original scale), and the business interpretation of each cluster (e.g., 'High-value frequent buyers').
context.expert_knowledge: Standardize with StandardScaler before K-means. Elbow method: plot inertia vs k, optimal k at the 'elbow' where marginal improvement decreases. Silhouette score ranges from -1 to 1; higher is better. KMeans(n_init=10, random_state=42). Cluster centers must be inverse-transformed to original scale for interpretation. Davies-Bouldin index also useful for cluster quality.
